name: fees_monotonic
informal: accumulatedFees is non-decreasing across any state transition: deposit, withdraw, or accrual
notes: Pre-state snapshot of accumulatedFees at function entry; assert post >= pre at exit. Fees only increase in accrual (+=fee) and are untouched in deposit/withdraw. 3/3 VCs proved safe by CHC/z3.

name: accrual_on_balance_change
informal: Any balance change in deposit or withdraw implies the internal accrual helper was invoked first
notes: Ghost bool _accrualApplied reset to false at function entry, set true by _applyAccrual(). Pre-state snapshot of balance. Assert: balance unchanged OR accrualApplied. 2/2 VCs proved safe by CHC/z3.

name: solvency_with_accrual
informal: totalAssets >= totalShares is preserved across deposit, withdraw, and accrual operations
notes: Inductive invariant: require(totalAssets >= totalShares) as precondition, assert it as postcondition. Deposit adds equally to both; withdraw subtracts equally; accrual only increases totalAssets. 3/3 VCs proved safe by CHC/z3.
